content: Resend recommends verifying a subdomain (e.g. send.example.com) rather than the root domain. Required DNS records (MX, SPF TXT, DKIM TXT at resend._domainkey) are account/domain-specific and must be copied from the Resend dashboard's Records tab, not hand-typed from generic examples. DMARC published separately at _dmarc.yourdomain starting at p=none.
